FX-DEBAND-001.says: The settings as added (threshold 4, softness 2, blur 8, diffusion 1, noise 1, every reduction 100, reseeding every frame) on `banded`: the bands smoothed, a little dither, the edge to the dark block kept; frame 1 has fresh dither.

FX-DEBAND-002.says: Blur, diffusion and noise all 0: the drawing as it is.

FX-DEBAND-003.says: Blur 8 alone: the bands smoothed, the edge pixels exactly as drawn.

FX-DEBAND-004.says: Blur 8 with Edge Blur Reduction 0: the edge pixels take the flat ground's blur too.

FX-DEBAND-005.says: Threshold 0, softness 0, blur 8: every pixel with any step is an edge, and a flat pixel meets only its own colour before an edge stops the blur: the drawing as it is.

FX-DEBAND-006.says: Threshold 255, blur 8: nothing is an edge, the whole layer blurred, the dark block's edge too.

FX-DEBAND-007.says: Threshold 2, softness 2, blur 8: the band steps of 3 levels are half edges, half held back.

FX-DEBAND-008.says: Diffusion 3 alone: pixels read from up to 3 away inside the flat ground; the edge pixels kept.

FX-DEBAND-009.says: Diffusion 3, Edge Diffusion Reduction 0: the edge pixels read from flat ground too.

FX-DEBAND-010.says: Noise 4 alone: dither on the flat ground, none on the edge pixels.

FX-DEBAND-011.says: Noise 4, Edge Noise Reduction 0: dither everywhere.

FX-DEBAND-012.says: Both reseed intervals 0: the dither and diffusion never change, frame 3 as frame 0.

FX-DEBAND-013.says: Both reseed intervals 2: frames 0 and 1 the same, frame 2 changed.

FX-DEBAND-014.says: View Edge Only, threshold 2: the edge weight as grey, white on the edge to the block, mid grey on the 3-level band steps, black on the flat ground.

FX-DEBAND-015.says: View Selected Edge: FX-DEBAND-001 with the edges laid over it in red.

FX-DEBAND-016.says: `holes`, with one empty pixel and a half-covered column: the empty pixel stays empty and the column keeps its covering.

FX-DEBAND-017.says: `flat`, one colour, as added: no edges, the blur changes nothing, only the dither shows.

FX-DEBAND-018.says: Blur keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 16 at frame 4, nothing else: frame 0 the drawing, then smoother.

FX-DEBAND-019.says: Both reseed intervals 2.6: their whole part, FX-DEBAND-013.

FX-DEBAND-020.says: View "edges", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEBAND-021.says: Edge Threshold 300, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEBAND-022.says: Blur Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEBAND-023.says: Noise Reseed Interval 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DEBAND-024.says: Noise Amount keyed to 40 at frame 4, above 32. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
